name: PNB Pay Wearable RuPay Debit Card
tagline: RuPay Classic debit card from PNB — domestic usage with NCMC transit.
description: PNB Pay -(banks' Wearable Products Based On RuPay On-the-go Technology Debit Card is a RuPay debit card from Punjab National Bank. Domestic usage; ATM limit bank-defined limits, PoS/eCom limit Rs. 60,000/day. NCMC offline transit enabled. Valid 7 years.
variant: The product shall be available in three forms – PVC Keychain, Leather Keychain and Mobile Sticker. It will be a Debit Card at back-end (linked to an account)

charges.label: Annual Fee

features: Can be used at all POS terminals, E Com Websites / Apps across India

notes: Any individual having KYC compliant account with the our bank and is otherwise eligible for Debit Card Issuance (including Savings and Current account holders).
